page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, fall into the weak and poor categories. However, multi-core benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core, stress-ng multi-core, and Passmark CPU tests, achieve average performance tiers. Memory bandwidth tests show average read and write speeds, though Passmark memory scores are relatively weak.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-thread performance. It is well-suited for database operations, multi-threaded data processing, and caching layers like Redis, where it achieves average transaction throughput. It is less suitable for single-threaded applications, high-throughput static web serving, or intensive LLM inference.
